transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’m here because flying has gotten really hard for me. I know it probably sounds irrational, and I understand planes are supposed to be safe, but when I think about getting on one, I get this overwhelming feeling like it’s going to go down. Like my body is convinced the plane is going to fall, even though my mind knows that doesn’t really make sense.
Do you ever have these intense fear episodes when you’re not flying or thinking about flying?

Not really, no. I mean, I don’t think so. It’s pretty tied to flying, or even the idea of having to fly. Otherwise I’m generally okay… at least, I haven’t noticed those same intense episodes out of nowhere. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
